Romain ROUYER commented on Maker Faire Paris 2019: "This is our first participation in the Maker Faire Paris 2019 (#MFP2019) which took place from 22 to 24 November 2019 at the Cité des Sciences et de l’Industrie.

Our volunteers took turns all weekend to present our activities (experiments, projects, HackNight evening, conference cycle, masterclass and other informal meetings).

List of projects presented :
- BCI Voyager: an artistic installation exploring the use of EEG in the tourism sector
- Autispace: an immersive mediation experience on Autism in the process of developing a prototype in virtual reality
- Knowledge graph: a work of datavisualization of the community’s knowledge
NeuroTech2042: a research project in Design Fiction on neurotechnologies that will be launched with the next conference cycle in early 2020
- Augmented Painting EEG: project combining art and artificial intelligence in partnership with the association Émotions Synesthètes

Here some ressources :
- Flickr album with a selection of photos <https://www.flickr.com/photos/rouffi7/sets/72157712070992991>
- Blog article (in french) <https://coglab.fr/makerfaireparis-2019/>
- The official link to the Maker Faire <https://paris.makerfaire.com/>
- Our twitter story <https://twitter.com/SCogLab/status/1197788846479548416>"
